name: People-Directory CDQR Audit
description: People-Directory (/people) CDQR+Dedup audit: captures /people screenshots + DOM, computes objective metrics (density + correctness counters + alias-dupe-cluster detection + stats-header presence), scores Correctness/Density/Quality/Relevance/Dedup 0-10, files one bug per dimension <=6, lands a roll-up report MR. The Dedup dimension directly encodes Matt Baker's complaint (Slack 1780418329.890109 — 'lots of dupe users, no top level stats displayed'): it scores whether alias rows are collapsed to canonical humans, whether unmerged dupe clusters are surfaced with a merge affordance, and whether a page-level aggregate stats header exists. Poured by a schedule trigger on a daily cadence so dupe + top-stats regressions on the Users directory surface as bug beads automatically. Parent epic {{PARENT_EPIC}}.

vars.name: TARGET_URL
vars.description: Beads-viewer base URL to audit. In-pod this is the port-forward tunnel http://localhost:8095 (see gardenio/docs/info-density-audit-harness.md for why the public ingress is unreachable from agent pods). The harness hits {{TARGET_URL}}/people.

vars.name: ITERATION
vars.description: Iteration tag (date stamp or fire-time ISO) used as the output directory name under docs/people-cdqr/<ITERATION>/. Used so multiple pours don't collide.

vars.name: PARENT_EPIC
vars.description: Tracking epic for this work. All bug beads filed by the file-issues step are parented here so the operator can browse one tree per dimension.

steps.title: People-dir CDQR ({{ITERATION}}): warm up {{TARGET_URL}}/people
steps.description:
## Step 1: Boot + Warmup

Confirm the audit target is reachable and /people returns < 400 before we burn cycles capturing/measuring.

### Prereq: open a local tunnel + mint a bearer

Follow `gardenio/docs/info-density-audit-harness.md` verbatim: `{{TARGET_URL}}` is expected to be `http://localhost:8095`. Agent pods have no public route to the viewer; port-forward to `svc/gardenio-beads-viewer:8095` and authenticate with a Keycloak `client_credentials` bearer (advice `ka-0000006483`, helper `gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/lib-keycloak-client-creds.sh`). Also port-forward `svc/gardenio-beads:8080` and bootstrap the operator row via `POST /v1/operators/me/aliases` so authenticated pages render real content.

```bash
export POD_NAMESPACE=${POD_NAMESPACE:-$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace 2>/dev/null || echo gardenio)}
export KC_RELEASE_NAME=${KC_RELEASE_NAME:-$POD_NAMESPACE}
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/lib-keycloak-client-creds.sh
VIEWER_BEARER=$(mint_client_credentials_token) || { echo 'BLOCKED: bearer mint failed'; exit 1; }
kubectl -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" port-forward svc/gardenio-beads 8080:8080 > /tmp/beads-daemon-pf.log 2>&1 &
BEADS_PF_PID=$!
kubectl -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" port-forward svc/gardenio-beads-viewer 8095:8095 > /tmp/beads-viewer-pf.log 2>&1 &
PF_PID=$!
trap 'kill $PF_PID $BEADS_PF_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" "http://localhost:8095/health" && break; sleep 1; done
curl -fsS -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"kind":"agent","subject":"gardenio-people-cdqr-audit","source":"audit-bootstrap"}' \
  http://localhost:8080/v1/operators/me/aliases | jq .
```

### Verify the page

With `VIEWER_BEARER` set, the directory must return < 400:
```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" "{{TARGET_URL}}/people")
printf '%-16s -> %s\n' "/people" "$code"
```

### Deliverables (post as comments, then close)
- Comment: HTTP status for /people.
- Comment: 'PASS' or failure detail.

If /people returns >= 400, do NOT close — file a bug parented to {{PARENT_EPIC}} and BLOCK (comment 'BLOCKED' and stop). A broken directory is itself the highest-severity Correctness finding.

steps.title: People-dir CDQR ({{ITERATION}}): capture screenshots + DOM for /people
steps.description:
## Step 2: Capture

Capture the /people directory screenshots (desktop + narrow) and raw rendered HTML, stored under `docs/people-cdqr/{{ITERATION}}/captures/`.

### Steps
1. Re-establish the tunnel + bearer (prereq block in step 1). Export `BEADS_VIEWER_BEARER=$VIEWER_BEARER`.
2. Branch off fresh main:
   ```bash
   git fetch origin && git checkout main && git pull --ff-only
   git checkout -b chore/people-cdqr/{{ITERATION}}
   ```
3. Capture screenshots at both viewports. Use the existing Playwright screenshot harness pointed at /people (the screenshot spec under `gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/` — if it has no `people` page entry yet, add one mirroring how `agents`/`gardeners` directory pages are captured; that harness extension is itself a valid first improvement). Output desktop + narrow PNG + HTML.
4. Also fetch the raw rendered HTML directly so measure/judge see real DOM:
   ```bash
   mkdir -p docs/people-cdqr/{{ITERATION}}/captures/html
   curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" "{{TARGET_URL}}/people" \
     -o docs/people-cdqr/{{ITERATION}}/captures/html/people.html
   ```
5. Move screenshots into the run dir under `captures/screenshots/{desktop,narrow}/people.png`.
6. Commit:
   ```bash
   git add docs/people-cdqr/{{ITERATION}}/
   git commit -m "chore(people-cdqr): capture {{ITERATION}} for /people"
   ```

### Deliverables
- Branch `chore/people-cdqr/{{ITERATION}}` with `captures/{html,screenshots}/` populated.
- Comment: `du -sh` of captures + commit SHA + confirmation both desktop & narrow PNGs exist.

If the harness fails, root-cause it (check `/tmp/beads-viewer-pf.log` for a dead port-forward, re-mint the bearer if expired) and BLOCK.

steps.title: People-dir CDQR ({{ITERATION}}): compute objective metrics for the five dimensions
steps.description:
## Step 3: Measure (objective; no judgement)

Compute the metric vectors that triage the five dimensions. Write a helper `gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/tools/measure-people-cdqr.py` that ingests the captures dir and emits `docs/people-cdqr/{{ITERATION}}/metrics.json`.

### Density (reuse measure-density.py shape)
Per html + png: `dom_element_count`, `text_byte_count`, `text_byte_per_dom`, `unique_links`, `data_fields`, and per-screenshot `near_white_ratio`, `mean_luma`, `pixel_count`.

### Correctness signals (grep captures/html/people.html)
| Signal | How |
| --- | --- |
| `error_markers` | count of `error`, `failed to`, `nil`, `panic`, `unprovisioned`, 5xx banners (case-insensitive) |
| `broken_links` | count of `href="#"`, `href=""`, slug-less `/u/`, or template-leak `{{` in href |
| `template_leaks` | literal `{{` / `}}` / `<no value>` in body |

### Dedup signals — THE HEADLINE (Matt's complaint, made numeric)
Parse the operator rows out of people.html (each `.people-row` / `/u/{slug}` link with its display + email). Then:
| Signal | How |
| --- | --- |
| `rows_rendered` | total operator rows the page renders |
| `dupe_clusters` | group rows by (lowercased email localpart UNION normalized display name); list every group of size > 1 |
| `dupe_cluster_count` | number of such groups (likely-same-human clusters) |
| `dupe_rows_excess` | sum over clusters of (size - 1) = how many rows are dupes |
| `has_stats_header` | bool: does the page render a page-level aggregate header (total humans / active-now / fleet open beads / dupe-cluster count) ABOVE the list? |
| `stats_fields_present` | which aggregate fields are present in that header (empty list if none) |

Cross-check dupe clusters against actually-linked aliases if the daemon exposes it (GET the operator's aliases); a cluster already merged via link-aliases is NOT an unmerged dupe. Record `unmerged_dupe_clusters` separately when determinable.

### Relevance signals
| Signal | How |
| --- | --- |
| `sort_order` | what the list is ordered by (active-recency? alpha?) — read from DOM order vs last-active chips |
| `segments_present` | does the page segment humans vs agents/bots, or is it one flat list? |

### Output `metrics.json`
```json
{
  "target_url": "{{TARGET_URL}}", "page": "/people", "iteration": "{{ITERATION}}",
  "density": {"desktop": {"near_white_ratio": 0.0, "data_fields": 0, "dom_element_count": 0, "text_byte_per_dom": 0.0}, "narrow": {}},
  "correctness": {"error_markers": 0, "broken_links": 0, "template_leaks": 0},
  "dedup": {"rows_rendered": 0, "dupe_cluster_count": 0, "dupe_rows_excess": 0, "unmerged_dupe_clusters": null, "has_stats_header": false, "stats_fields_present": []},
  "relevance": {"sort_order": "", "segments_present": false}
}
```
Commit the helper + metrics.json on the branch.

### Deliverables
- `measure-people-cdqr.py` + `metrics.json` committed.
- Comment: compact table of headline numbers, ESPECIALLY `dupe_cluster_count`, `dupe_rows_excess`, `has_stats_header`.
- If a screenshot is unreadable, mark its block `null` and warn — do not BLOCK.

steps.title: People-dir CDQR ({{ITERATION}}): score Correctness / Density / Quality / Relevance / Dedup
steps.description:
## Step 4: Judge — the CDQR+Dedup rubric

Produce a 0-10 score + verdict for each of the five dimensions, combining the objective metrics (step 3) with a visual review of the screenshots. **You MUST visually inspect** `docs/people-cdqr/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/desktop/people.png` (and narrow) with the Read tool — the screenshot is the source of truth; metrics only triage.

### The five dimensions

**C — Correctness** — Any `template_leaks > 0` / `error_markers > 0` / 5xx ⇒ score <= 3. Broken/slug-less links, wrong counts, garbled rows ⇒ deduct. 10 = every datum accurate, every link works.

**D — Density** — Anchor on desktop `near_white_ratio`: >= 0.55 ⇒ <= 4; 0.40-0.55 ⇒ 5-6; 0.25-0.40 ⇒ 7-8; < 0.25 readable ⇒ 9-10. Cross-check `data_fields`/`dom_element_count`. A flat name-list with acres of white scores low.

**Q — Quality** — alignment, consistent chip/card styling, typographic hierarchy, empty-states, no overflow, narrow viewport doesn't break. 10 = looks designed, not assembled.

**R — Relevance** — Does the directory answer 'who is on this fleet and who's busy?' Useful default sort (active-first), sensible segmentation (humans vs agents/bots), the right per-row signals. Penalize a flat unordered list.

**D̂ — Dedup & Top-Stats** (THE HEADLINE — Matt's exact complaint):
- If `dupe_cluster_count > 0` AND the page renders raw alias rows (no canonical collapse) ⇒ score <= 3.
- If `has_stats_header == false` ⇒ cap at <= 4 regardless of other dedup quality (the 'no top level stats' half of the complaint).
- Full marks require BOTH: (1) alias rows collapsed to canonical humans with unmerged-dupe clusters surfaced + a merge affordance, AND (2) a page-level aggregate header (total humans, active-now, fleet open beads, unmerged-dupe-cluster count) above the list.
- 10 = zero raw dupes rendered, dupe clusters flagged for merge, and a crisp stats header orients the page.

### Output `docs/people-cdqr/{{ITERATION}}/verdicts.json`
```json
{
  "iteration": "{{ITERATION}}", "page": "/people",
  "scores": {
    "correctness": {"score": 0, "verdict": "broken|weak|ok|good|excellent", "observations": "...", "issues": [], "recommendations": []},
    "density":     {"score": 0, "verdict": "...", "observations": "...", "issues": [], "recommendations": []},
    "quality":     {"score": 0, "verdict": "...", "observations": "...", "issues": [], "recommendations": []},
    "relevance":   {"score": 0, "verdict": "...", "observations": "...", "issues": [], "recommendations": []},
    "dedup":       {"score": 0, "verdict": "...", "observations": "...", "issues": [], "recommendations": []}
  },
  "overall": {"score": 0.0, "headline": "one-line state-of-the-users-directory"}
}
```
Bands: 0-3 broken, 4-5 weak, 6-7 ok, 8-9 good, 10 excellent. `overall.score` = mean of the five.

### Deliverables
- `verdicts.json` committed.
- Comment: a 5-row scorecard (dimension | score | verdict | top recommendation) + the one-line headline.
- Full `verdicts.json` pasted into a comment for the file-issues step.

steps.title: People-dir CDQR ({{ITERATION}}): file bug beads per low-scoring dimension
steps.description:
## Step 5: File Issues

For every dimension in `verdicts.json` scoring **<= 6** (weak or broken), file ONE bug bead with that dimension's concrete recommendations. A 7+ dimension does not get a bug.

### Per-dimension bug bead
```bash
kd create "Users directory CDQR: <Dimension> scored <N>/10 — <one-line>" \
  --type=bug --project=gardenio -p 2 \
  -l project:gardenio -l area:beads-viewer -l kind:people-cdqr -l "cdqr:<dimension>" \
  --description "## CDQR audit context

Iteration: {{ITERATION}}
Target: {{TARGET_URL}}/people
Dimension: <Correctness|Density|Quality|Relevance|Dedup>
Score: <N>/10  (verdict: <verdict>)

## Observations
<verbatim from verdicts.json>

## Issues
- <bullet>

## Recommended fixes
- <bullet>

## Evidence
- Desktop: docs/people-cdqr/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/desktop/people.png
- Narrow:  docs/people-cdqr/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/narrow/people.png
- Metrics: docs/people-cdqr/{{ITERATION}}/metrics.json

parent({{PARENT_EPIC}})"
```

### Deduplication (per dimension)
Before filing, search for an open bead with the same dimension scope:
```bash
kd list --status=open -l kind:people-cdqr -l "cdqr:<dimension>" 2>&1
```
If one exists, comment the new iteration's score + evidence on it instead of filing a duplicate. If the dimension has recovered to 7+, comment that and propose closing it.

### Deliverables
- Comment listing each filed-or-updated bug bead ID + its dimension + score.
- If all five dimensions score 7+, comment 'All five CDQR dimensions >= 7 this iteration — nothing to file 🎉' and close the step.
- Do NOT close {{PARENT_EPIC}} — the report step rolls up first.

steps.title: People-dir CDQR ({{ITERATION}}): publish roll-up report and land MR
steps.description:
## Step 6: Report + Land MR

Produce a rolled-up report on {{PARENT_EPIC}} and land captures+metrics+verdicts on main via an MR so future iterations can diff.

### Steps
1. Build `docs/people-cdqr/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md`:
   - Header: iteration, target (/people), date.
   - **CDQR+Dedup scorecard**: 5-row table — dimension | score/10 | verdict | filed bug bead.
   - Headline + overall score.
   - Inline-embed the desktop screenshot.
   - Trends: if a previous `docs/people-cdqr/<previous>/verdicts.json` exists, diff each dimension's score and flag deltas >= 1.0.
   - Index of bug beads filed/updated this iteration.
2. Commit + push + open MR:
   ```bash
   git add docs/people-cdqr/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md
   git commit -m "chore(people-cdqr): {{ITERATION}} roll-up report"
   git push -u origin chore/people-cdqr/{{ITERATION}}
   glab mr create \
     --title "chore(people-cdqr): {{ITERATION}} audit (overall <N>/10)" \
     --description "Automated Users-directory (/people) CDQR audit.\n\nReport: docs/people-cdqr/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md\nParent: {{PARENT_EPIC}}\nOperator: Matt Baker" \
     --remove-source-branch --squash-before-merge
   gb mr link <this-bead-id> <mr-url>
   ```
3. Wait for CI green; on transient flake, retrigger via the pipeline API (NEVER close/reopen).
4. Self-merge once green (gardenio repo, pre-authorized — advice ka-0000002230).
5. Comment on {{PARENT_EPIC}}:
   ```
   CDQR iteration {{ITERATION}} complete. Page: /people
   Scores — C:<n> D:<n> Q:<n> R:<n> Dedup:<n>  (overall <n>/10)
   Bug beads: <list>
   Report: <permalink at merge SHA>
   ```
6. Close this step bead. The schedule trigger fires the next iteration on cadence.
